summary: Inventiva S.A. filed a Form 6-K detailing a comprehensive refinancing transaction announced June 1-2, 2026. The company offered 27,272,727 ADSs at $4.40 per ADS via underwritten offering led by Leerink Partners, Stifel, and Stifel Europe, expecting net proceeds of ~$110.8 million. Proceeds will repay the EIB loan (~€63M outstanding) and buy back warrants, plus fund a new debt facility with BlackRock and Claret Capital (€130M committed tranches, €75M initial drawdown). Closing expected June 5, 2026. This capital restructuring addresses near-term debt maturities (Dec 2026, Jan 2027) and provides liquidity. Watch for dilution (27.3M new shares) and regulatory triggers for drawdown conditions.
